Our values.

Our values are at the heart of everything we do and keep us focused on making a
positive impact—for our customers, team members, and community.

Lead with Integrity.

We continuously strive to earn the trust of our customers, partners, and team members.

Push Boundaries.

We think big—pushing ourselves and our customers to break new ground and reach new heights.

Operate as Owners.

We hold ourselves accountable and take ownership of our responsibilities and actions.

Grow Together.

We create opportunities for all, believing that everyone deserves a fair shot at success.

Perks and benefits.

We believe happy employees do the best work––and that leads to happy customers. We
invest in our team by offering a variety of perks and benefits that help them thrive
in and out of the office.

Bluevine Voices.

Bluevine Voices are employee-led groups focused on supporting underrepresented communities by helping to elevate awareness across the organization, creating impact for their community, and fostering a true sense of belonging for all.

Mission

At Bluevine, everyone feels like they truly belong.

Vision

Empower everyone with the tools, programs, and environment to nurture our diversity, equity and inclusion in pursuit of our vision.

We do this by elevating our diverse representation, honoring differing perspectives and experiences, and creating fair and equitable opportunities for all.

not a bank.
